/cdp-mode.from: pass it once and later commands and daemon restarts keep the strict semantics.
/cdp-mode.to: pass it once and later commands keep the strict semantics. Daemon restarts keep the pin; an explicit close releases it so other sessions can take the tab, and the next pinned command pins again.

/engines/obscura.from: MCP tools use the same provider through `extraArgs`: `["--engine", "obscura", "--executable-path", "/path/to/obscura"]`.
/engines/obscura.to: MCP tools use the same provider: set `AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH` in the MCP server's environment and pass `extraArgs: ["--engine", "obscura"]`, because `--executable-path` is rejected in `extraArgs`.
